title: One shared error handler returns consistent JSON errors; API never returns HTML error pages
verify_by: Find the 4-argument error middleware in evidence.security.errorHandlers; on staging, evidence.staging.unknownApiRoute.isJson must be true.
fix_hint: Register one error middleware last that logs the error and returns {error:{code,message,requestId}} with the right status; add a JSON catch-all 404 for /api/*.

title: Async errors are forwarded; process-level unhandledRejection/uncaughtException handled
verify_by: Open the app entry file; check evidence.security.processHandling and that async handlers are wrapped (express-async-errors, asyncHandler or Express 5).
fix_hint: Wrap async route handlers (or upgrade to Express 5), and add process.on("unhandledRejection"/"uncaughtException") handlers that log, then exit so PM2 restarts the process.

title: All request bodies, params and queries validated with a schema library
verify_by: evidence.security.validationLibs lists a library; open route files and confirm each route validates req.body, req.params and req.query.
fix_hint: Add zod/joi/ajv validation middleware per route; reject unknown fields and return 400 with field-level messages.

title: Correct HTTP status codes; no 200 with an error body
verify_by: Review route handlers for res.json({error}) or res.json({success:false}) without a status; compare with evidence.staging probe statuses.
fix_hint: Return 4xx/5xx via the shared error handler; replace 200-with-error bodies and add a test per route family.

title: List endpoints are paginated and bounded; no unbounded SELECT * responses
verify_by: Open list routes; look for LIMIT/OFFSET or cursor params with a server-side maximum, and for SELECT * without LIMIT.
fix_hint: Add limit (default 50, max 200) and cursor/offset parameters to every list query and return paging metadata.

title: Request body size limits and request timeouts configured
verify_by: evidence.security.bodyLimit and evidence.security.requestTimeouts; evidence.nginx.timeouts for client_max_body_size and client_body_timeout.
fix_hint: Set express.json({limit}) explicitly, set server.requestTimeout/headersTimeout, and client_max_body_size plus client_body_timeout in nginx.

title: Success is returned only after the DB commit; queue jobs acknowledged after commit
verify_by: Review write handlers: the response (and queue ack) must come after await commit / await query, never before or in a fire-and-forget promise.
fix_hint: Await the transaction commit before responding; ack queue jobs only after commit; use an outbox table for events that must not be lost.

title: API contract documented (OpenAPI or equivalent) and versioned
verify_by: evidence.repo.openapi lists a spec file; routes are prefixed /api/v1 or equivalent.
fix_hint: Generate or write an OpenAPI 3 spec, commit it, and version the route prefix.

title: Integration tests cover failure paths (bad input, auth fail, 503/504, DB down)
verify_by: evidence.repo.testFiles; open tests and look for 400/401/403/503 assertions and a DB-down case.
fix_hint: Add integration tests for invalid input, missing/expired token, forbidden role, and database unavailable returning 503.

title: The health endpoint and every route in the user-approved --safe-routes list return no 5xx on staging (unknown if no safe routes were given)
verify_by: evidence.staging.health.status and evidence.staging.safeRoutes[].status are all below 500. Mark unknown if staging was skipped or no safe routes given.
fix_hint: Fix the root cause of each 5xx found (check server logs on staging), then re-run the probe.

title: Every table and column referenced in code exists in the migrated schema (no wrong tables)
verify_by: evidence.db.missingInDb (needs --check-db) and evidence.db.missingInMigrations (local) must both be empty.
fix_hint: Add a migration for each missing table/column or correct the wrong table name in the query; add a CI test that applies migrations then runs the queries.

title: No unexpected or unreferenced tables; staging schema matches migrations
verify_by: evidence.db.unreferencedInDb (needs --check-db) compared with the migrated table list.
fix_hint: Drop or document unreferenced tables via a reviewed migration (after a verified backup); regenerate staging from migrations.

title: Migrations are versioned, ordered and apply cleanly on an empty database
verify_by: evidence.db.local.migrationFiles shows ordered, numbered files; CI applies them to an empty database.
fix_hint: Use a migration tool with ordered versions; add a CI job that runs all migrations on a fresh Postgres.

title: Migrations are additive with a tested rollback or forward-fix plan; CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY on live tables
verify_by: Open recent migrations for DROP/ALTER TYPE, and CREATE INDEX without CONCURRENTLY; look for down/rollback files or documented forward-fix.
fix_hint: Split destructive changes into expand/contract steps, use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, and write a down migration or runbook step for each.

title: Every table has a primary key; required NOT NULL, UNIQUE and foreign keys exist
verify_by: evidence.db.tablesWithoutPk (needs --check-db) is empty; review migrations for NOT NULL/UNIQUE/FOREIGN KEY on key columns.
fix_hint: Add primary keys, NOT NULL, UNIQUE and FOREIGN KEY constraints in a migration (backfill and validate first).

title: Indexes on foreign keys and hot filter/sort columns
verify_by: evidence.db.fkWithoutIndex (needs --check-db) is empty; review hot queries for matching indexes.
fix_hint: Create indexes (CONCURRENTLY) on each unindexed foreign key and on frequent WHERE/ORDER BY columns.

title: Pool sizes fit max_connections (pool x processes x apps sharing the DB)
verify_by: Compute evidence.db.local.poolSettings max x evidence.pm2 instances x apps and compare with evidence.db.remote.maxConnections.
fix_hint: Lower pool max or instance count so total connections stay under ~80% of max_connections, or add PgBouncer.

title: Runtime DB role is least-privilege (not superuser, no DDL)
verify_by: evidence.db.remote role guard result (needs --check-db with the runtime role) or connection string review in config.
fix_hint: Create an app role with only SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on required tables; run migrations with a separate owner role.

title: Multi-step writes use transactions
verify_by: evidence.db.local.transactionUsage; open handlers that perform more than one write and confirm BEGIN/COMMIT or a transaction helper.
fix_hint: Wrap multi-statement writes in a transaction with rollback on error.

title: Statement and idle-in-transaction timeouts set
verify_by: evidence.db.remote.roleSettings (needs --check-db) or evidence.db.local.timeoutSettings in pool config.
fix_hint: Set statement_timeout and idle_in_transaction_session_timeout on the app role or pool options.

title: Saves are upserts by id; guards against whole-array replace and unexpected record-count drops
verify_by: evidence.db.local.upsertUsage; review save handlers for DELETE-then-INSERT of whole collections and for count-drop guards.
fix_hint: Switch to INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE per record; reject saves that would remove more than a set fraction of existing rows unless explicitly confirmed.

title: Staging and production use separate DB credentials and instances
verify_by: Compare DB host/user in staging and production env templates and deploy config; no shared URL.
fix_hint: Provision a separate staging database and credentials; rotate any credential that was shared.

title: Automated backups exist
verify_by: evidence.backups lists backup scripts/cron entries (pg_dump, pgBackRest, managed snapshots) or provider settings are cited.
fix_hint: Schedule automated daily pg_dump or managed snapshots with retention, and alert on failure.

title: A restore has been tested and recorded
verify_by: Find a restore log or runbook entry with a date and result in docs.
fix_hint: Restore the latest backup to a scratch database, verify row counts, and record date and outcome in the runbook.

title: Backups encrypted and stored off-host
verify_by: Review the backup script/config for encryption and a remote destination (object storage, another region).
fix_hint: Encrypt backups (gpg/age or storage-side) and copy them to off-host storage with restricted access.

title: RPO/RTO defined
verify_by: Find stated RPO and RTO in docs.
fix_hint: Define and document RPO/RTO, and confirm backup frequency and restore time meet them.

title: Deploy gate requires a verified backup before migrations
verify_by: evidence.repo.deploy.backupStep and the deploy script: a backup step must run and be checked before migrations.
fix_hint: Add a deploy step that takes a backup, verifies it (size/checksum/test restore), and aborts the deploy if that fails.

title: Runbook forbids destructive commands without backup and rollback plan
verify_by: Find runbook text covering DROP/TRUNCATE/bulk DELETE approval and backup requirement.
fix_hint: Add a runbook section requiring backup, rollback plan and second-person review before any destructive command.

title: Parameterized queries only; no string/template concatenation with user input
verify_by: evidence.sql.hits must be empty or each hit reviewed and shown to contain no user input.
fix_hint: Replace concatenated SQL with parameterized queries ($1, $2) and pass values as an array.

title: Dynamic identifiers (sort column, table, direction) whitelisted
verify_by: Open code that builds ORDER BY / column / table names from input and confirm a fixed allowlist.
fix_hint: Map user-supplied sort/column/table values through a constant allowlist object; reject anything else.

title: No hardcoded secrets in the repo or git history; secret scanning in place
verify_by: evidence.secrets.hits and evidence.secrets.gitHistoryHits are empty; evidence.repo.ci.hints.secretScan is true.
fix_hint: Remove secrets from code, rotate every exposed secret, purge history if needed, and add gitleaks/trufflehog to CI.

title: No fallback secrets; production refuses to start without JWT_SECRET and other required secrets
verify_by: evidence.secrets.hits of type jwt-fallback is empty; startup code throws when required env vars are missing.
fix_hint: Remove "|| default" fallbacks and validate required secrets at startup, exiting in production when absent.

title: XSS defenses: output escaping, no unsanitized innerHTML, CSP set
verify_by: evidence.security.innerHtml hits reviewed; evidence.security.csp true or staging Content-Security-Policy header present.
fix_hint: Remove or sanitize (DOMPurify) innerHTML/dangerouslySetInnerHTML uses and add a Content-Security-Policy header.

title: CSRF protection (SameSite, tokens) wherever cookies authenticate
verify_by: evidence.security.csrf and cookie flags; mark na if auth uses only Authorization headers (cite the code).
fix_hint: Set SameSite=Lax/Strict on auth cookies and add CSRF tokens for state-changing routes, or move auth to bearer headers.

title: CORS is a strict allowlist; no wildcard with credentials
verify_by: evidence.security.cors (wildcard, credentials) and evidence.staging.corsPreflight.reflectsOrigin must be false.
fix_hint: Replace origin:"*" or reflected origins with an explicit allowlist from config; never combine wildcard with credentials.

title: Security headers present (HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, referrer policy)
verify_by: evidence.staging.securityHeaders, or evidence.nginx.securityHeaders when staging is skipped.
fix_hint: Add Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options and Referrer-Policy via helmet or nginx add_header ... always.

title: No known critical/high dependency vulnerabilities; lockfile committed
verify_by: evidence.deps counts (critical and high must be 0) and evidence.repo.lockfiles is non-empty.
fix_hint: Run npm audit fix or upgrade the vulnerable packages, commit the lockfile, and gate CI on npm audit --audit-level=high.

title: SAST (Semgrep/CodeQL) runs in CI
verify_by: evidence.repo.ci.hints.sast is true and the workflow file is cited.
fix_hint: Add a CodeQL or Semgrep workflow that runs on every pull request.

title: No command injection or path traversal; no exec with user input
verify_by: evidence.security.execWithVariables is empty or each hit reviewed; file-path handlers use path.resolve plus a base-directory check.
fix_hint: Use execFile with an argument array and fixed command; validate file paths against a base directory.

title: Outbound URLs allowlisted (SSRF)
verify_by: Review code that fetches user-supplied URLs (fetch/axios/http.get with input).
fix_hint: Resolve and check outbound hosts against an allowlist and block private/loopback ranges.

title: Uploads validated by type, size and content; stored outside web root
verify_by: evidence.security.uploadLibs; if present, review limits, MIME/content sniffing and destination; na if no uploads (cite).
fix_hint: Enforce size limits, verify magic bytes, rename files, and store outside the web root or in object storage.

title: Passwords hashed (argon2/bcrypt), JWT expiry and rotation defined, secure cookie flags
verify_by: evidence.security.passwordHashing, evidence.security.jwtExpiry and cookie flags.
fix_hint: Use argon2id or bcrypt (cost >= 12), set expiresIn on every JWT with a refresh/rotation plan, and set httpOnly, secure, sameSite on cookies.

title: No stack traces or version banners in responses
verify_by: evidence.staging.stackTraceLeak false and evidence.staging.banners empty (Server/X-Powered-By).
fix_hint: Disable x-powered-by, set server_tokens off, and return generic error bodies in production.

title: TLS everywhere, HTTP->HTTPS redirect, automated cert renewal
verify_by: evidence.staging.tls and evidence.staging.httpRedirect; evidence.nginx.tls (protocols, 301 redirect, certbot/ACME).
fix_hint: Serve only HTTPS with TLS 1.2+, redirect port 80 with 301, and automate renewal (certbot timer) with expiry alerting.

title: Secrets live in a secrets manager or env, rotatable without downtime
verify_by: Review config/deploy docs; evidence.secrets.trackedEnvFiles must be empty.
fix_hint: Move secrets to a secrets manager or server-side env files outside git, and document a rotation procedure.

title: DAST/pen test completed on staging before go-live
verify_by: Find a dated DAST/pen-test report in docs. Mark unknown if none; this skill never runs attack tools.
fix_hint: Run OWASP ZAP baseline or a pen test against staging with written authorization and fix findings.

title: Every API route is behind auth middleware; explicit public allowlist; a test enforces it
verify_by: evidence.routes.unprotected matches an intentional public allowlist; a test fails when a new route is unauthenticated.
fix_hint: Apply auth middleware at the router level, list public routes explicitly, and add a test that walks the route table.

title: Tenant/user ID comes from the verified token, never a client header or param
verify_by: Grep handlers for req.headers["x-user-id"|"x-tenant-id"], req.body.userId and similar used for authorization.
fix_hint: Derive user and tenant IDs only from the verified token claims; ignore client-supplied identity fields.

title: Object-level access checks (IDOR); cross-tenant request returns 403/404
verify_by: Open handlers loading records by id and confirm ownership/tenant filtering; find a cross-tenant test.
fix_hint: Scope every query by tenant/owner from the token and add tests that cross-tenant access returns 403/404.

title: Role-based authorization on admin routes
verify_by: Admin routes in evidence.routes use a role-check middleware; open it to confirm roles come from the verified token.
fix_hint: Add requireRole middleware to all admin routes and test each role boundary.

title: No debug/admin/docs endpoints publicly reachable (/debug, /metrics, /api-docs, /swagger, /.env, /.git, /server-status)
verify_by: evidence.staging.sensitivePaths: none returns 200 with real content. Mark unknown if staging was skipped.
fix_hint: Remove the endpoints or restrict them to loopback/VPN or authenticated admins; deny dotfiles in nginx.

title: DB, Redis, PM2 and internal ports not publicly exposed; bound to loopback or firewalled
verify_by: Review postgresql.conf/pg_hba, redis.conf bind, compose port mappings and firewall docs; nginx upstreams use 127.0.0.1.
fix_hint: Bind DB, Redis and app ports to 127.0.0.1 or a private network and allow only 80/443 publicly.

title: Redis is passworded or loopback-only; staging and prod do not share Redis
verify_by: Review redis config/URL in env templates for requirepass/ACL or loopback bind and separate hosts per environment.
fix_hint: Set requirepass/ACL or bind to loopback, and give staging its own Redis instance.

title: nginx does not serve source maps, backups, dotfiles
verify_by: evidence.nginx.denyDotfiles, denySourceMaps, autoindex; evidence.staging.sensitivePaths for .map files.
fix_hint: Add location blocks denying /\., *.map and backup extensions; disable autoindex; do not deploy source maps to the web root.

title: Responses do not over-expose fields (hashes, internal IDs, other tenants' data)
verify_by: Review serializers and SELECT * responses for password hashes, tokens and internal columns.
fix_hint: Return explicit field lists (DTOs) instead of raw rows and strip hashes/tokens.

title: Refused requests are logged without tokens
verify_by: Review auth failure logging: it should log reason and request ID but never the token or password.
fix_hint: Log 401/403 events with request ID, route and user ID only; redact Authorization headers.

title: Global rate limiting at nginx and/or app
verify_by: evidence.ratelimit.libraries and evidence.ratelimit.nginx (limit_req_zone and limit_req).
fix_hint: Add limit_req in nginx and/or express-rate-limit globally with sensible per-IP limits.

title: Strict limits on login, password reset, token and signup endpoints
verify_by: evidence.ratelimit.authRoutes: each has limiterOnRoute true or an nginx location with limit_req.
fix_hint: Apply a strict limiter (e.g. 5-10 requests/minute per IP and per account) to login, reset, token and signup routes.

title: Limits keyed per user/tenant/IP, with a shared store when multi-process
verify_by: Review limiter config for keyGenerator and store (Redis) when PM2 cluster or multiple hosts are used.
fix_hint: Key limits by user/tenant when authenticated, else IP, and use a Redis-backed store across processes.

title: 429 with Retry-After; clients back off
verify_by: evidence.ratelimitProbe (429 and Retry-After/RateLimit-* headers) or limiter config showing headers enabled.
fix_hint: Return 429 with Retry-After and enable standard RateLimit headers; make clients honor them.

title: Brute-force lockout and alerting on spikes
verify_by: Review login code for attempt counters/lockout and docs for alerts on 401/429 spikes.
fix_hint: Add progressive lockout per account/IP and alert when 401/429 rates spike.

title: Connection, body and header timeouts guard against slow-client attacks
verify_by: evidence.nginx.timeouts: client_header_timeout, client_body_timeout, send_timeout, keepalive_timeout; Node server headersTimeout.
fix_hint: Set client_header_timeout, client_body_timeout, send_timeout and limit_conn in nginx; set Node headersTimeout/requestTimeout.

title: Heavy endpoints (exports, reports, search) have tighter limits or are queued
verify_by: Identify heavy routes in evidence.routes and check for specific limiters or queueing.
fix_hint: Add stricter per-route limits to heavy endpoints or move them to a background queue.

title: Multiple app instances behind an nginx upstream or PM2 cluster mode
verify_by: evidence.nginx.upstreams (more than one server) or evidence.pm2 exec_mode=cluster with instances > 1.
fix_hint: Run at least two instances using PM2 cluster mode (instances: "max" or 2+) or an nginx upstream with several servers.

title: Upstream health handling (max_fails/fail_timeout or equivalent) tied to a readiness endpoint
verify_by: evidence.nginx.upstreams max_fails/fail_timeout and evidence.health endpoints.
fix_hint: Set max_fails and fail_timeout on upstream servers and expose a readiness endpoint that checks the database.

title: App is stateless (sessions, uploads, caches not in process memory or local disk)
verify_by: Grep for in-memory session stores, local-disk uploads and module-level caches that must be shared.
fix_hint: Move sessions to Redis/DB, uploads to object storage, and shared caches to Redis.

title: Upstream keepalive on; $connection_upgrade map instead of hardcoded Connection "upgrade"
verify_by: evidence.nginx.upstreams keepalive, evidence.nginx.connectionHardcodedUpgrade false, connectionUpgradeMap true.
fix_hint: Add keepalive to upstreams with proxy_http_version 1.1 and a map $http_upgrade $connection_upgrade block.

title: Timeouts consistent across browser, gateway, nginx, app and DB
verify_by: Compare evidence.nginx.timeouts, Node server timeouts and DB statement_timeout: each layer inward should be shorter.
fix_hint: Align timeouts so client > nginx > app > DB statement timeout, and document the values.

title: Load test at expected peak with headroom, results recorded
verify_by: Find a recorded load-test report in docs. Mark unknown if none; this skill never runs load tests.
fix_hint: Run a load test on staging at 2x expected peak (with authorization) and record latency, errors and saturation.

title: Heavy work off the request path (queue, 202); one queue-worker consumer set
verify_by: Review long-running handlers and queue worker setup (BullMQ etc.) for a single consumer set.
fix_hint: Move heavy work to a queue, return 202 with a status endpoint, and run workers as one separate PM2 app.

title: Single points of failure (DB, Redis, nginx) identified and accepted or mitigated
verify_by: Find a SPOF list in docs with owner decisions.
fix_hint: Document each single point of failure with its mitigation or explicit risk acceptance.

title: Compression and cache headers for static assets
verify_by: evidence.nginx.gzip and long-lived Cache-Control on hashed static assets.
fix_hint: Enable gzip/brotli and set Cache-Control immutable with long max-age for hashed assets.

title: Graceful shutdown drains connections on SIGINT/SIGTERM
verify_by: evidence.security.processHandling.sigterm and server.close usage; evidence.pm2 kill_timeout.
fix_hint: On SIGTERM/SIGINT stop accepting connections, call server.close, close the DB pool, then exit; set PM2 kill_timeout above drain time.

title: Readiness check (app + DB) separate from deep check (Redis etc.)
verify_by: evidence.health.endpoints shows separate liveness/readiness/deep routes; open the handler to confirm what each checks.
fix_hint: Expose /health (liveness), /ready (app + DB) and an authenticated /health/deep for optional dependencies.

title: Optional dependencies degrade with a visible fallback
verify_by: Review Redis/cache/third-party call sites for try/catch fallback and a logged or surfaced degraded state.
fix_hint: Wrap optional dependency calls in fallbacks and report degraded status in the deep health check.

title: Retries use exponential backoff on 502/503/504, never on 401/403
verify_by: Review client/API wrapper retry logic (client code, axios interceptors).
fix_hint: Retry only idempotent requests on 502/503/504 with exponential backoff and jitter; never retry 401/403.

title: Memory caps (max_memory_restart, Redis maxmemory)
verify_by: evidence.pm2.max_memory_restart and Redis maxmemory settings in config.
fix_hint: Set max_memory_restart in PM2 and maxmemory plus an eviction policy in Redis.

title: Auto-restart on crash with crash-loop protection
verify_by: evidence.pm2 autorestart, max_restarts, min_uptime, restart_delay or exp_backoff_restart_delay.
fix_hint: Enable autorestart with max_restarts, min_uptime and exp_backoff_restart_delay in the PM2 ecosystem file.

title: Failed queue jobs do not retry forever; dead-letter handling
verify_by: Review queue job options for attempts, backoff, and failed-job handling; na if no queue (cite).
fix_hint: Cap attempts with exponential backoff and route exhausted jobs to a dead-letter queue with alerting.

title: Timeouts on all outbound calls (DB, HTTP, Redis)
verify_by: Review pool options (connectionTimeoutMillis), fetch/axios timeout, Redis commandTimeout.
fix_hint: Set explicit timeouts on every outbound client (DB, HTTP, Redis).

title: Maintenance mode ready (503 + Retry-After, JSON 503 for API)
verify_by: evidence.nginx maintenance location returning 503 with Retry-After; API returns JSON 503.
fix_hint: Add an nginx maintenance flag returning 503 with Retry-After and a JSON body for /api.

title: Multi-hour soak shows flat memory
verify_by: Find a soak-test result in docs. Mark unknown if none.
fix_hint: Run a multi-hour soak on staging under realistic load and record memory and handle counts.

title: One verify command runs lint, typecheck, tests, build and smoke test
verify_by: evidence.repo.scripts.verify lists a package.json containing a verify script covering those steps.
fix_hint: Add an npm run verify script that chains lint, typecheck, tests, build and a smoke test; run it in CI.

title: CI required by branch protection; deploy blocked unless checks passed for that commit
verify_by: evidence.repo.ci.files and repo settings/docs showing required status checks.
fix_hint: Enable required status checks on the main branch and make the deploy job depend on them.

title: Lint catches undeclared variables (no-undef) and hook rules
verify_by: evidence.repo.lintConfig: eslint config enabling no-undef and react-hooks rules.
fix_hint: Enable eslint:recommended (no-undef) and eslint-plugin-react-hooks, and fail CI on errors.

title: Zero-downtime deploy: pm2 reload, wait_ready with process.send("ready")
verify_by: evidence.pm2.wait_ready, evidence.security.processHandling.sendReady and evidence.repo.deploy.pm2Reload.
fix_hint: Use pm2 reload, set wait_ready and listen_timeout, and call process.send("ready") after the server listens.

title: Automatic rollback on failed post-deploy smoke test, rehearsed
verify_by: Open the deploy script: smoke test then automatic rollback; find a rehearsal record.
fix_hint: Add a post-deploy smoke test that triggers rollback to the previous release on failure, and rehearse it on staging.

title: Required env vars validated at startup and in the deploy gate
verify_by: evidence.security.envValidation and the deploy script check for required variables.
fix_hint: Validate required env vars at boot (envalid/zod) and verify them in the deploy gate before switching traffic.

title: nginx and PM2 configs are in version control
verify_by: evidence.nginx.file and evidence.pm2.file are tracked repo files.
fix_hint: Commit the nginx and PM2 configs and deploy them from the repo.

title: Staging mirrors prod; deploy and rollback rehearsed on staging
verify_by: Find docs describing staging parity and a rehearsal record.
fix_hint: Align staging versions/config with production and rehearse deploy and rollback there.

title: Deploy runs nginx -t then reload, never restart
verify_by: evidence.repo.deploy.nginxTest true, nginxReload true, nginxRestart false.
fix_hint: Run nginx -t and abort on failure, then nginx -s reload (never restart).

title: Persistence paths tested against a real database, not mocks
verify_by: Review test setup for a real Postgres (docker/service container) used by persistence tests.
fix_hint: Run persistence tests against a disposable real Postgres in CI.

title: Every production change traceable to a reviewed PR
verify_by: Repo settings or docs show PR review required and deploys tied to merged commits.
fix_hint: Require pull-request review on main and deploy only tagged/merged commits.

title: Structured logs with correlation IDs; no tokens or PII
verify_by: evidence.observability.loggers and correlationId hits; review log calls for tokens/PII.
fix_hint: Use a structured logger (pino/winston), attach a request ID to every log line, and redact tokens and PII.

title: Error monitoring (Sentry or similar)
verify_by: evidence.observability.errorMonitoring lists an SDK and it is initialised in the server entry.
fix_hint: Install and initialise an error-monitoring SDK in server and client with release tagging.

title: Symptom-based alerts page a named on-call
verify_by: Find alert rules and an on-call roster in docs.
fix_hint: Create alerts on error rate, latency and health failures that page a named on-call person.

title: Latency, error-rate and saturation metrics; SLOs defined
verify_by: evidence.observability.metrics (prom-client etc.) and SLO docs.
fix_hint: Expose request latency, error-rate and saturation metrics and define SLOs.

title: Runbook per alert; incident process preserves evidence first
verify_by: Find a runbook per alert and an incident process that says to capture evidence before restarting.
fix_hint: Write a runbook per alert and add an incident step to capture logs/state before remediation.

title: External uptime monitor on the readiness endpoint
verify_by: Find monitor configuration or docs pointing at the readiness URL.
fix_hint: Configure an external uptime monitor on the readiness endpoint with alerting.

title: Log rotation configured
verify_by: evidence.observability.logRotation (logrotate, pm2-logrotate or library).
fix_hint: Configure logrotate or pm2-logrotate with size/age limits and compression.

title: Least-privilege roles; MFA for admin, server and cloud access
verify_by: Find access policy docs or screenshots showing roles and MFA enforcement.
fix_hint: Enforce MFA on cloud, server and admin accounts and prune roles to least privilege.

title: Individual, logged production DB access; no shared credential
verify_by: Find docs on DB access: named accounts and audit logging.
fix_hint: Issue named DB accounts, enable connection and statement logging, and remove shared credentials.

title: Immutable audit log of sensitive changes and admin actions
verify_by: Find an audit log table/service written on sensitive actions and protected from edits.
fix_hint: Record who/what/when for sensitive actions to an append-only audit log.

title: Data-protection mapping: retention, deletion/export, PII masked in logs and non-prod
verify_by: Find a data inventory/retention policy and non-prod masking practice.
fix_hint: Document PII locations, retention and deletion/export procedures; mask PII in logs and non-prod data.

title: Breach-notification process with named owners
verify_by: Find a breach response document with named owners and notification timelines.
fix_hint: Write a breach-notification procedure with owners, contacts and regulatory deadlines.

title: Named system owner; at least two people can deploy and recover; architecture documented
